target.selection: Fresh deterministic Python sorted root names, first min(10, child count), never reselect or expand. Empty selection rejects. Each selected child root and every descendant count toward its shard cap.
target.host_premise: Trusted fresh disposable GitHub Ubuntu VM without concurrent writers; this is not an atomic filesystem transaction or proven writer exclusion.
target.audit_before_mutation: Completely census every selected tree, then reverify all metadata, exact listings, SDK root identity and mount table before the first mutation. Descriptor-relative nofollow traversal; reject hardlinked regular files, special types, device changes, SDK/descendant mounts and metadata changes.
target.deletion: Frozen helper removes only each bound selected directory's descendants; successor removes that selected child root. Leaf symlinks unlinked without following. SDK root remains; final root names must equal original unselected suffix.
target.interruption: Any interrupted removal is terminal and may leave partial deletion. No retry. Actual removed nodes are irreversible on that VM without reinstall or replacing the disposable VM.

limits.count_semantics: Caps bound accepted distinct metadata nodes, not metadata syscall or relisting counts. One rejected boundary observation may occur. Name-byte accounting is cumulative full relative paths, not process RAM. Historical prefix totals do not substitute for fresh admission or measured free space.

execution.runtime: CPython 3.12 Linux x86_64 root, main and single thread; all three dedicated environment flags; clean default signals before cleanup and frozen probe.
execution.predeletion_checks: Workflow pins, prefix synthetic tests, 53 frozen setup tests, 21 frozen qualification source-closure tests; authenticated frozen probe and harness runtime checks before SDK target access.
execution.probe_condition: Release all SDK descriptors and disarm cleanup alarm. Invoke frozen setup probe once only when actual /tmp acquisition_headroom_met is true. Frozen probe rechecks capacity and bound setup independently.
execution.local_tests: Owned synthetic temporary directories and mocked runtime/target/audit/timer/probe boundaries only. Never the Mac SDK or actual setup probe.
